camp.what: Fixed berry trees along routes; each gives a berry once a day.

Apricorn trees, one Apricorn a day. Kurt in Azalea Town turns them into Poké Balls: Red into Level Ball, Blue into Lure Ball, Yellow into Moon Ball, Green into Friend Ball, Pink into Love Ball, White into Fast Ball, Black into Heavy Ball.
Bottled milk that restores HP. Johto's comes from the MooMoo Farm on Route 39, where a sick Miltank needs berries.
A Shuckle holding a berry can turn it into Berry Juice (Cianwood's Shuckle). Whether later games keep the trick: verify.
